notes: Diagnostic problematic, not independent finance-expert validation. Source rows show pretax loss narrowing by 35.2 USD million and tax expense falling by 8.5, which together narrow GAAP net loss by 43.7. Both final uncertainty and persisted review deny the reduced tax drag; the saved review also reverses the directional interpretation. The main GAAP-versus-adjusted divergence and the blocked needs_review state are otherwise coherent, so this is a content/guard miss, not a false ledger-state claim.
